environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Apache Tomcat 8.5.23 with the legacy monolith WAR deployed directly. Instance is in a public subnet with an Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or load balancer in front. JDK 8u151. No RASP agent installed. Application serves responses directly to clients.
